gamenews.headline: Bem-vindo!
gamenews.message:
Bem-vindo ao Valdraken!

O mundo é No-PvP: ninguém te ataca. O jogo é você contra os monstros, os bosses e o ranking.

O básico do servidor

• Client 15.24, premium grátis para todos
• Até 5 personagens online por conta
• Loot x2 e respawn x3 para todos
• Server save todo dia às 17:55 (horário de Brasília)

No server save as tasks diárias e os bosses diários voltam.

Por onde começar

Faça a ilha do Tutorial do Novato e depois siga a Jornada por Level, as duas na lista ao lado.

Os guias completos, com mapa e coordenadas, estão no site:
www.valdraken.com.br

gamenews.headline: Tutorial do Novato
gamenews.message:
Todo personagem nasce na ilha do Tutorial, do level 1 ao 20. São poucos minutos.

Passo a passo

1. Abra os dois baús da sala inicial:
outfit Citizen completa (+1% de experiência) e montaria Racing Bird (+100 de capacidade).

2. Faça a aula de craft da bancada. É o mesmo sistema dos melhores sets do jogo.

3. Primeira porta: 40 em qualquer skill (ou magic level). Treine nos bonecos da ilha.

4. Segunda porta: level 20. Ao chegar no 20 o servidor já te leva para o outro lado.

5. Terceira porta: leve a arma da sua vocação (Guardian Axe, Hammer of Wrath, Thaian Sword, Composite Hornbow, Wand of Starstorm, Hailstorm Rod ou Fists of Enlightenment).

Recompensa

100 crystal coins (só na primeira vez) e Thazoran vira a sua cidade.

As mensagens das portas falam em level 50, mas o que vale é o que está acima. Errar uma porta não custa nada.

gamenews.headline: Jornada por Level
gamenews.message:
O caminho natural de um personagem. Use como mapa, não como regra.

1 a 20
Ilha do Tutorial, aula de craft e as três portas.

50 a 500
Annihilation e Elf Quest, as hunts com bônus do Valkir Covenant e, a partir do 500, a Tower e Ahmun.

750 a 1750
Legendary Tier (a forja fica em Ahmun, portão de level 750), Karazan e as hunts Primal.

2500
Shadow Ascension, o set 2500 e as facções Angels x Demons.

3000 a 3750
Zerathys, a Demonic Quest e o set Best in Slot de level 3750.

4000+
Kelrath e seus bosses, o Path of Valdraken e a Escada dos Dragões.

6000+
O reset: você volta ao level 9 com bônus permanentes.

A lista de quests em ordem de level, com o guia de cada uma, está no site em Guias > Quests.

gamenews.headline: Bônus de Iniciante
gamenews.message:
Até o level 500 o servidor dá uma força extra para quem está começando.

Experiência

+100% de experiência no level 8, diminuindo aos poucos até zero no level 500.

Blessings grátis

Até o level 500 você tem todas as blessings de graça. Morrer não custa os seus itens.

Loot bags de presente

Personagens sem reset ganham uma loot bag na Store Inbox ao chegar nos levels
8, 50, 100, 180, 300, 500, 750 e 1000.

Tasks

Até o level 1499 a recompensa em gold das tasks diárias vale 20 vezes mais.

gamenews.headline: Morte e Blessings
gamenews.message:
Quando você morre, volta para o templo da sua cidade (Thazoran, depois do Tutorial).

Até o level 500

As blessings são grátis e automáticas.

Depois do level 500

Use !bless antes de caçar. O comando compra todas as blessings de uma vez.

Sem blessing você pode perder itens e parte do seu progresso ao morrer.

Confira os seus bônus e proteções ativos com !mybonus.

gamenews.headline: Stamina
gamenews.message:
A stamina afeta a experiência e também o loot.

Acima de 39 h (verde)
+50% de experiência.

De 14 h a 39 h
Experiência e loot normais.

14 h ou menos
Experiência, loot e gold pela metade. Os loots extras (prey, criatura do dia, talisman) somem.

0 h
Você não ganha experiência, loot nem gold.

A stamina volta enquanto você está deslogado.

gamenews.headline: Tasks Diárias
gamenews.message:
As tasks são a principal fonte de gold e tokens do servidor.

• No seu primeiro login depois do server save (17:55) todas as tasks disponíveis são aceitas sozinhas.
• Ao completar o número de kills, a recompensa é entregue na hora.
• Use !task para ver o progresso e escolher tasks.

Até o level 1499 a recompensa em gold vale 20 vezes mais.

Os bosses diários têm o próprio tempo de espera: veja com !boss.

gamenews.headline: Valkir Covenant
gamenews.message:
Aumente a dificuldade do seu jogo em troca de mais experiência.

• Cada nível de Covenant dá +1% de experiência, até o nível 110.
• Em troca, as criaturas causam mais dano em você e ficam mais resistentes.

Para escolher o nível você precisa de uma Valkir Golden Coin na inbox.

Achou difícil demais? Use a Valkir Golden Coin de novo para diminuir.

Os Covenants caem de vários bosses (Skullfrost, Firehead, Leviathan, Lich King e os dragões) e também estão na Store.

Há hunts com buff de Covenant a partir do level 8. A lista completa está no site, em Sistemas > Valkir Covenant.

gamenews.headline: Valdraken Tower
gamenews.message:
A partir do level 500

21 andares de bosses, solo, com 30 minutos de limite.

Quanto mais longe, melhor a posição no ranking da Tower.

Use !tower para ver o Top 10 e o seu tempo de espera para entrar de novo.

gamenews.headline: Legendary Tier
gamenews.message:
A partir do level 750

A forja do equipamento: até 10 níveis de dano, vida e mana na sua peça.

A forja fica em Ahmun, no portão de level 750.

O tier pode ser transferido para a peça nova quando você trocar de set, então nada se perde.

Veja o bônus atual com !legendary.

gamenews.headline: Facções
gamenews.message:
Angels x Demons, a partir do level 2500

• Missões diárias e 10 ranks por facção.
• Bônus no craft dos sets 2500, 3500 e 3750.
• A facção que vencer a semana ganha +5% de experiência na semana seguinte.

O placar da semana está no site, em Rankings.

gamenews.headline: Path of Valdraken
gamenews.message:
A partir do level 4000

Expedições solo num mapa só seu.

Evolua o mapa na Estátua, adicione afixos para aumentar o desafio e a recompensa, e desça até o Nemesis.

O guia completo está no site, em Sistemas > Path of Valdraken.

gamenews.headline: Escada dos Dragões
gamenews.message:
Do level 4000 aos 14 resets

Oito dragões em sequência, cada um pedindo um número de resets:

Caraxes (só level 4000) · Syrax 1 · Vaghar 2 · Viserion 4
Rhaegal 6 · Drogon 8 · Meraxes 11 · Balerion 14

Vida, força, custo e recompensas de cada um estão no site, em Sistemas > Escada dos Dragões.

gamenews.headline: Reset
gamenews.message:
A partir do level 6000

Você volta ao level 9 e ganha, para sempre, a cada reset:

• +20% de dano em ataques e spells
• +2% de proteção contra todos os elementos (até 100%)
• Vida, mana e +1500 de capacidade
• Acesso às hunts e quests exclusivas de Kelrath

O reset cobra tokens, Hunting Task Points e gold, multiplicados pelo número do reset. Tokens podem estar no stash e o gold no banco.

Use !resetinfo para ver o que falta e !reset em área de proteção para resetar.

Os itens equipados vão para a sua inbox.

gamenews.headline: Quest Log and Tracker
gamenews.message:
The quest log and the quest tracker provide valuable information to navigate quests.
 

Quest Log

You can open your quest log via the respective shortcut button or by pressing Ctrl+U.

Once you have started a quest, its name will appear in the quest log under the section "Quest Lines".

Click on a quest to the individual missions it contains in the upper box on the right-hand side.

Click on a mission to see details of this task in the box below.

Completed quests and missions are marked by a green tick.

You can pin quests to the top of the list by clicking this little pin button:

 

You can also manually hide quests from the list by clicking this little eye button:

 

This checkbox allows you to toggle between showing completed quests or removing them from the list:

 

If you tick the checkbox below you can display all your hidden quests:

 

You can sort quests alphabetically or by completion status.
You can use the search field to find quests by name.

 

Quest Tracker

You can easily track your quest progress via the quest tracker window in your sidebar.

Open your quest log and click on the button "Quest Tracker" in the lower left corner to open the quest tracker in your sidebar.

To add a quest to it, simply go to the quest of your choice in the quest log, select the task or mission you want to track and tick the small box "Show in quest tracker".

To remove a quest from the quest tracker, right-click on its entry and select Remove.

Quests that are accepted are automatically added to the tracker, completed quests are automatically removed. These settings are activated by default. You can change them in the quest tracker's context menu.

Click the small button in the upper right corner to open it.

There, you can also remove all currently tracked entries or all completed quests at once via the quest tracker menu.

 

Free account players can track up to five quests at once per character, Premium players can track up to 20 quests at once per character.

gamenews.headline: Combat and Hunting
gamenews.message:
Click on a monster in the game window or in the battle list to attack it.
Use autoattack and attack spells to deal damage.

 

Press a hotkey or an action button to cast your spells.
The spells you can use depend on your vocation:
 

Maintain your health with healing spells and potions.

 

Defeat monsters to gain experience points.
When you level up, your health and mana are restored.

 

Search corpses for loot such as gold, food or equipment.

 

Press Alt+left-click or Alt+Q to loot everything from nearby corpses with a single click.

 

Your capacity and backpack slots limit how much your character can carry.

 

Inventory

Your inventory shows your characters' equipment.
It is split up into individual slots, representing the locations where items can be equipped.

1) Head Slot: for headgear
2) Torso Slot: for armor
3) Legs Slot: for leg gear
4) Feet Slot: for footwear
5) Amulet Slot: for a necklace or an amulet
6) Weapon Slot: for a weapon, e.g. sword, a bow, a rod or a wand
7) Ring Slot: for a ring
8) Container Slot: for a container such as a backpack
9) Shield Slot: for a shield, a spellbook or a quiver 
10) Extra Slot: for useful items such as a light source

To equip an item simply move it into the slot it is intended for.

 

Some equipment pieces require a certain vocation or minimum level.

 

Regenerate faster with food

The field below your inventory shows if your character is affected by a special condition.
If you see this icon there, it means that your character is hungry.

 

Hungry characters regenerate health every 4 seconds and mana every 6 seconds.
Eating food grants the saturated state,
boosting your regeneration to 3 seconds (health) and 5 seconds (mana). 

 

There is plenty of food in Tibia. You can loot it, buy it in shops, harvest or cook it.

 

What every adventurer needs

Always carry a rope in your backpack to be able to pull yourself up from holes.

Look for rope spots, little round shadows on the floor which indicate a hole above it.
Left-click on your rope, then left-click on the shadow to pull yourself up.

 

With a shovel, you can create holes in loose stone piles to go down one level.

Left-click on your shovel, then left-click on the stone pile to go down by opening a hole.

gamenews.headline: Imbuing
gamenews.message:
Imbuing allows you to temporarily boost your equipment!

Visit Albinius north of Thais, collect heavy old tomes for him and hand them over via the key word temple to unlock the ability to use imbuing shrines.

Items with imbuement slots can be imbued. Look at an item to see if it has any slots.

Depending on the item, different imbuements are available:

  • critical hit
  • leeches
  • elemental damage
  • elemental protection
  • skill boosts
  • capacity boost
  • speed boost

Imbuements vary not only in effect but also in power.
Get Premium to apply intricate imbuements and unlock more powerful imbuements through quests!

Click on an imbuing shrine in a city temple to open the imbuing dialog.

Select "Pick Item" and click on the item you want to imbue.

Select one of the imbuements that are available for your item to see the required astral resources and gold.

If you have the required resources and gold, click the green arrow on the right side to imbue the item.

Since the summer update 2025, imbuing an item always succeeds.

For most imbuements, time only decreases when the imbued item is equipped during combat.

You can also imbue blank imbuement scrolls to create intricate and powerful imbuement scrolls that can be traded.

Click on an imbuing shrine and select "Imbue Scroll" to set it up.

An imbued scroll can also be used by a free account player. 

If you want to remove all imbuements from an item before they have run out, you can buy a cleansing scroll from Albinius.

gamenews.headline: Prey Creatures
gamenews.message:
Activate a prey to gain a bonus when hunting certain monsters!
 

Press to open the prey dialog.

 

 

(1) You can also click the prey button to open the prey window in your sidebar.

(2) Left-click in the prey window to open the prey dialog.

Select your prey or click here if you want to reroll the monsters to choose from:

 

You get a free list reroll every 20 hours. The gold price for a list reroll depends on your character level.

 

Once you have selected your prey, click here to activate it and get a random bonus: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, or improved loot.

 

If you are looking for a specific monster, you can use five Prey Wildcards to directly select the prey of your choice.

 

 

Use a Prey Wildcard to reroll your bonus to get one with a higher value.
Prey Wildcards can be purchased for Tibia Coins in the Store or can be obtained at the reward shrine. 

 


You want a different prey but would like to keep your current bonus?

Roll for a new monster list while you already have an active prey. Select a new prey from the list and activate it. Your hunting time will be reset to 2 hours.

 


You want a different bonus but would like to keep your current prey?

Roll for a new bonus while you already have an active prey. Your hunting time will be reset to 2 hours with your new bonus.

 

Tick the option "Automatic Bonus Reroll" to have your prey bonus
rerolled automatically whenever it is about to expire. 
Each Automatic Bonus Reroll consumes one of the Prey Wildcards.


You have found your perfect prey and bonus combination?
Tick the option "Lock Prey" and your prey time will be set back whenever it is about to expire.
Each time the Lock Prey option triggers, it will consume five of your Prey Wildcards.

 

The prey window shows your current prey, your bonus and the remaining time for the prey.
Hover over your prey for a tooltip with details.

 

By the way: Prey time only decreases while hunting!

 

You can activate up to 3 preys simultaneously.
All players can use the first prey slot, Premium players can also use the second slot. Additional prey slots can be unlocked permanently by purchasing them for Tibia Coins in the Store.

gamenews.headline: Bestiary and Charms
gamenews.message:
Gather useful details about Tibian creatures in the Bestiary to unlock hunting benefits.
 

You can access the Bestiary via the respective tab in the Tibia Cyclopedia.

 

 

Here, you can see various creature classes in Tibia, the total number of creatures in each class and how many of them you have already killed at least once.

Click on a class to see all creatures within that class.

A creature is considered unknown to you if you have not killed it at least once after the winter update 2017. 

  

Unknown creatures appear as shadows.
As soon as you kill a creature for the first time, it will be displayed with its name and in colour
Click on a coloured creature to see details about it.

  

On a creature's detailed page, you see its difficulty level and a kill counter.
It tells you how many times you need to kill this creature to unlock further details.

 

A creature's difficulty determines the number of kills you need to unlock the three stages of detail.
Each stage provides additional information such as basic stats, elemental sensitivities and loot.
Very rare loot items will only be displayed if you have completed the creature's entry and looted the item at least once.

The Bestiary Tracker keeps track of your kills.

 


You can add a creature by ticking the box "Track Kills" in a Bestiary entry.

 

Charms

Charms grant various offensive, defensive, or passive bonus effects against the Bestiary creatures they are assigned to.
There are two types of charms: major and minor.

The Charms tab in the Cyclopedia provides a comprehensive overview of all charms.
There, you can unlock, upgrade, assign, and clear charms.

 

A creature can have both a major charm and a minor charm assigned simultaneously,
but each charm can only be assigned to one creature at a time.

Major charms are unlocked and upgraded using Charm Points, which you receive for completing a creature's Bestiary entry.
The number of Charm Points you receive depends on the creature's difficulty level.
Assign a major charm to a completed Bestiary entry to benefit from its bonus effect against that creature.

 

Unlocking and upgrading major charms yields Minor Charm Echoes. Use those to unlock and enhance minor charms.
Promoting your character also grants 100 Minor Charm Echoes.

Minor charms can be assigned to a creature as soon as you have unlocked stage 2 of its Bestiary entry.

 

Both your current Charm Points and Minor Charm Echoes, as well as their maximum capacity,
are displayed at the bottom of the Charms tab.

You can assign charms via the Charms tab or directly on a creature's completed Bestiary page.

 

If you want to use an assigned charm against a different creature or if you want to assign a different charm to a creature that is already linked to a charm,
you can remove the charm for a gold fee via the Charms tab or on the creature's Bestiary page.

 

In the Charms tab, you can also reset all of your charms 
if you want to redistribute your Charm Points and Minor Charm Echoes. 
Up to and including level 100, the cost is fixed at 100,000 gold.
Starting from level 101, the cost is now 100,000 gold + 11,000 gold per level.
The first reset is free.

 

Premium players can have six charms assigned at the same time, while free accounts can have two. 
In the Store you can purchase the Charm Expansion to be able to assign all of your unlocked charms at the same time. 
It also reduces the amount of gold you have to pay for clearing or resetting charms by 25%.

gamenews.headline: Influenced and Fiendish Creatures
gamenews.message:
Influenced and fiendish creatures are more dangerous but offer exclusive loot.
 

Influenced and fiendish creatures have a low chance to spawn in place of a regular monster.
They are stronger versions of regular monsters, empowered by Sinister Embrace.

Influenced Creatures

 
The number below an influenced creature's name shows its Sinister Embrace stacks.
The higher the number, the stronger they are and the higher the potential to yield more dust.

Dust is a non-tradable resource required for using the Exaltation Forge in Tibia.
You can only get dust by killing influenced creatures.

Fiendish Creatures

Fiendish monsters are much rarer than influenced monsters.
You can use the spell Find Fiend to locate them.

 

Beware though! They are much stronger than influenced monsters.
Their power equals that of an influenced creature with 15 stacks,
indicated by the exclamation mark below their name.

Fiendish yield more dust, and you can also loot a tradable resource called slivers.

Whenever you kill a fiendish creature, you also have a chance to obtain a soul core.

 

You can use it in the Soulpit to fight increasingly difficult waves of the soul core creature. 
If you are successful, you unlock Animus Mastery for this creature, a permanent experience boost.

Gems

Influenced and fiendish creatures can drop gems for each vocation:

Guardian gems for knights, marksman gems for paladins,
sage gems for sorcerers and mystic gems for druids.

 

Gems come in three sizes: lesser, regular and greater.
You can either trade these gems with other players,
or reveal those for your vocation in the Gem Atelier.
There, you can place them in your Wheel of Destiny to amplify your character's power.

gamenews.headline: Weapon Proficiency
gamenews.message:
Upgrade your favourite weapons through the new Weapon Proficiency system.
 

You can access the Weapon Proficieny tree via the context menu of a specific weapon or via the respective shortcut button.

 

Each proficiency has up to seven levels, offering one to three unlockable perks per level.

 

Equip a weapon and kill Bestiary creatures and bosses to increase your proficiency with this weapon. 
The higher the Bestiary difficulty of a creature, the more proficieny progress you gain from it.

 

Only one perk per Proficiency Level can be active at a time

Selecting a perk for your weapon can be done anywhere, but changing or removing a perk is only possible in protection zones. 

Please also note: With the introduction of the Weapon Proficiency system, all characters now have a default critical hit chance of 5% and 10% critical extra damage. Any additional crit chance gained from items is added on top. Monsters have received a 1% critical hit chance for auto attacks. To maintain balance in the game, weapons no longer provide any critical hit chance in their basic version.

  

The Weapon Proficiencies interface allows you to check the trees of all weapons. 
You can apply filters to narrow down the list.

gamenews.headline: Exaltation Forge
gamenews.message:
The Exaltation Forge allows players to upgrade weapons, armour, and helmets with powerful effects. Items can be increased in tiers, with the maximum number of tiers for an item being limited by its classification into one of four groups.

 

The Exaltation Forge lies north of the Adventurers' Guild.

 

Influenced Creatures

 

In order to make use of the forge, resources are required. The first one is dust. In order to get dust, which is non-tradable, players have to kill influenced monsters.

 

These creatures have a low chance to spawn in place of a regular monster and are stronger versions of regular monsters. The higher the number below their name, the stronger they are, and the higher the potential to yield more dust.

 

Fiendish Creatures

 

Fiendish monsters are even stronger than influenced monsters. They also give more dust, as well as a new tradable resource called slivers.

 

Fiendish monsters are much rarer than influenced monsters. The spell Find Fiend indicates the direction to the nearest fiendish creature.

 

Dust Limit and Conversion

 

A player can only carry 100 dust at first, but this limit can be increased to a maximum of 325 by spending dust.

 

Dust can also be converted into slivers, and slivers can be converted into exalted cores.

 

 

Effects

Upgrading an item through the Exaltation Forge provides it with the following effects:

  • Onslaught (for weapons): An attack may deal 60% bonus damage, which is additive to critical hits.
  • Ruse (for armour): Provides a chance of completely avoiding damage from an attack.
  • Momentum (for helmets): Grants a chance every two seconds to reduce all existing spell cooldowns by two seconds if the battle sign is present. This affects individual spell cooldown and the secondary group cooldown, but not the primary group cooldown.
  • Transcendence (for legs): Provides a chance to transform into the vocation's Avatar Stage 3 for seven seconds, turning hits into formidable critical strikes and reducing the damage received.
  • Amplification (for boots): This passive bonus amplifies the effect of tiered items you have equipped by increasing their trigger chance.

A higher tier increases the trigger chance of these effects.

Fusion

 

Two of the same item need to be fused, in addition to a sum of gold (higher tiers demand higher prices), and 100 dust.

Success of a fusion is not guaranteed; there is a possibility that the second item will be either reduced by one tier, or, in case it was a tier 0 item, it will be destroyed. Using exalted cores, the success of the operation can be increased, however, and the risk of losing a tier gets reduced, should the fusion fail.

For items of classification 4, Convergence Fusion enables you to fuse different objects of the same body slot with guaranteed success. This option is available for a substantially increased gold cost, reflecting its benefit.

 

Transfer

 

A a tier can be transferred from another item of the same classification. The target item, which is to receive the tier, has to be tier 0, while the source item, from which the tier is transferred, has to be at least tier 2. This process requires 100 dust, one exalted core, and a sum of gold.

The transfer is guaranteed to succeed. The target item receives the source item's tier by a reduction of one tier, while the source item itself will be destroyed during the transfer.

For items of classification 4, Convergence Transfer allows you to transfer a tier without tier loss. This option is available for a substantially increased gold cost, reflecting its benefit.

gamenews.headline: Bosstiary
gamenews.message:
Check which bosses you have killed and how often, and earn cool benefits for making progress.
 

You can access the Bosstiary via the respective tab in the Tibia Cyclopedia.

 

The first kill of a boss opens up the respective entry in the Bosstiary.
A kill only counts towards your progress if your particaption was high enough.
Depending on how often a boss can be killed within a certain amount of time,
it falls into one of three categories: Bane, Archfoe or Nemesis.

There are three progress levels you can unlock for each boss:

Prowess allows you to assign this boss to a boss slot which gives you an equipment loot bonus of 25% for this boss.
Expertise allows you to display this boss on a Podium of Vigour in your house or guildhall.
Mastery grants you an additional 25% equipment loot bonus when this boss is assigned to a boss slot.


You also receive boss points for unlocking a new progress level.
By accumulating boss points you can gradually increase the equipment loot bonus of the boss slot.

 

Also, a second boss slot will be unlocked once you reach 1500 boss points.

The Bosstiary Tracker allows you to track your progress with bosses that you have defeated at least once. You can select the bosses you want to track via the Bosstiary.

The tracker also shows the cooldown of bosses: A white hourglass indicates an expired cooldown. A red hourglass indicates a cooldown that is still running. Hovering over the symbol shows the full cooldown time.


The Daily Boosted Boss ties in with Bosstiary.
With every server save, a randomly drawn boss of the Archfoe category contains more equipment loot.
Also, one kill of this boss counts as three for your Bosstiary.

Making progress in the Bosstiary will also bestow temporary and permanent titles on your character.
Moreover, there is a highscore for "Boss Points".

gamenews.headline: Wheel of Destiny
gamenews.message:
The Wheel of Destiny enables you to further specialise your character based on your needs and playstyle as you level up.

The Wheel of Destiny offers something to look forward to for all promoted Premium characters above level 50.

You will gain promotion points which you can use to unlock various benefits ranging from small perks all the way up to new powerful spells and abilities depending on your vocation.

You can spend and remove points for free!

Whenever you have promotion points to spend, simply open the Wheel of Destiny and spend your points. You can do this any time. To remove or reset already invested points you have to be in a temple, though.

Perks

The Wheel of Destiny is divided into four domains. Each domain contains nine slices. So in total, there are 36 slices which you can fill with points to improve your character.

 

  • Dedication Perks have small effects. They gradually increase existing characteristics, e.g. your HP or your mana. Every promotion point invested into a Dedication Perk raises the bonus in question a bit till you have assigned the maximum number of points possible for this slice.
  • Conviction Perks have medium to large effects. They augment existing spells, grant vocation-specific passive abilities or generally useful bonuses, e.g. elemental resistance. You unlock a Conviction Perk once you have filled the respective slice to the max. Most Conviction Perks can be found more than once within the Wheel of Destiny. When they are unlocked, their effects add up.
                   
  • Revelation Perks have powerful effects. They grant new spells or strong passive effects with considerable impact. There are four Revelation Perks and each of them is assigned to one of the four domains of the wheel. You unlock a Revelation Perk once you have spent enough promotion points in the respective domain. Spending more points in the same domain will unlock the more powerful stages two and three of this Revelation Perk.

The Wheel of Destiny Presets allow you to switch between various wheel setups while you are in the temple. Presets can also be imported and exported. This means you can also share your setups with friends or transfer them to a different character.

The Wheel of Destiny Planner on the website allows you to select a vocation and freely distribute points. It also displays how many Promotion Points are required for your current specification and you will also be able to import and export your ingame setups. You can also set a limit for the points when using Planner.

gamenews.headline: Wheel of Destiny: Gem Atelier
gamenews.message:
The Gem Atelier in the Wheel of Destiny offers expansive ways to amplify your character's power.

Archfoe bosses, influenced and fiendish creatures can drop gems for each vocation:

Guardian gems for knights, marksman gems for paladins, sage gems for sorcerers and mystic gems for druids.

 

You can either trade gems or reveal those for your vocation in the Gem Atelier.

You can access it by opening the Wheel of Destiny and clicking on the tab "Gem Atelier".
There, you can reveal gems to discover their inherent powers, thus binding them to your character.
This means they can no longer be traded or given to other characters.


Gems come in three sizes granting various boosts for your character:

  • Lesser gems have 1 basic mod: stats (HP, mana, capacity, mitigation multiplier), basic resistances (fire, earth, energy, ice) or stat + basic resistance (e.g. HP + fire resistance)
  • Regular gems have 2 basic mods: resistances (basic resistances, holy, death, physical, mana drain, life drain)
  • Greater gems have 2 basic mods and 1 supreme mod: critical extra damage, life leech, mana leech, dodge, spell augments, revelation mastery

 

To enjoy the bonuses of gem mods, place the gem in the vessel that matches its domain affinity.
The activation of mod bonuses depends on how many Vessel Resonance perks you have filled in this domain of the wheel:

 

The Wheel of Destiny consists of four domains.
When a gem is revealed, it not only gains mods but also a colour representing its domain affinity.
You can switch the domain affinity of a gem clockwise for gold.

 

  • None: Sealed vessel, no mod active. (bottom right in the image above)
  • One: Dormant vessel, first mod active. (bottom left in the image above)
  • Two: Awakened vessel, first and second mod active. (top left in the image above)
  • Three: Radiant vessel, all mods active, including supreme mods. (top right in the image above)

Active mods are displayed with their icon in the Vessel Resonance perks in the wheel.
To the left you see a perk without an active Mod, to the right you see it with an active Mod:

 

If the Vessel Resonance matches the size of the gem you have placed into this vessel,
you will gain a bonus of +1 to both Damage and Healing for lesser and regular gems.
Placing a greater gem into a radiant vessel will increase this bonus to +2.

Gems can be locked or unlocked by clicking on the small lock icon located at the top left corner of the gem.
When a gem is locked, you cannot change its domain or destroy it.

 

Via the Button "Dismantle", you can dismantle gems that you do not need anymore.
In return, you will receive fragments.

 

Fragments can be used to enhance your mods in the Fragment Workshop.
You cannot dismantle gems that are locked, placed in a vessel, or are the last one you have of a particular domain.

You can check a list of all available mods in the Wheel of Destiny Planner on the website by selecting a vocation and then clicking in one of the four vessels. In the dropdown lists, you can see which mods are available for each mod slot.

gamenews.headline: Wheel of Destiny: Fragment Workshop
gamenews.message:
The Fragment Workshop allows you to upgrade mods to harness the full power of your gems.

You can access the Fragment Workshop by opening the Wheel of Destiny and clicking on the respective tab.

There, you can enhance your gem mods from Grade I to Grade IV to increase their power.

 

These upgrades require gold and fragments. Fragments are remnants of shattered gems.

 

Gems can be looted from Archfoe bosses, influenced and fiendish creatures.

To obtain fragments, you can either crush unrevealed gems with a crusher or amber crusher, or you can dismantle revealed gems in the Gem Atelier.

Fragments can also be purchased from jewelry shop NPCs, though this convenient option is priced accordingly.

 

 

 

Depending on the quality of the gem and whether it is revealed or unrevealed, you will receive a certain number of fragments.

  Lesser Gem Regular Gem Greater Gem
Unrevealed Gem 1-4 lesser fragments 2-8 lesser fragments 1-4 greater fragments
Revealed Gem 1-5 lesser fragments 2-10 lesser fragments 1-5 greater fragments

How to enhance mods in the Fragment Workshop?

If you click on a mod, you can check its unlocked and unlockable grades and their effects in the "Enhance Mod Grade" section.
It also shows how much gold and how many fragments you need to invest to unlock the next grade for this mod.
For a basic mod, you need lesser fragments; for a supreme mod, you need greater fragments.

 

Raising mods to their highest grade also earns you permanent promotion points: 
For every Grade IV mod, you will receive an additional Promotion Point for your Wheel of Destiny.

If you enhance a mod, its grade will be raised on all gems the mod appears on.
However, the effectiveness of the enhanced mod on a gem is limited
by the grade of the mods that come before it on the gem.
If they have a lower grade, the mod in question is also limited to that lower grade.

 

A special icon and tooltip in the Gem Atelier inform you if the grade of an enhanced mod is limited by the grade of a preceeding mod.

gamenews.headline: Depot Chest and Inboxes
gamenews.message:
Depots can be found in all major cities in Tibia. Visit them to access your stored items.
 

Click on a locker in a depot to open your character's personal depot locker.
It contains your depot chest, your Supply Stash, your inbox, and grants you access to the Market.

 

Depot Chest and Depot Boxes

Click on the depot chest in your locker to open it. You can access your depot chest from any depot.

It contains 17 numbered depot boxes in which you can store your items.

If you are a free account player you can store up to 2,000 items in your depot chest. Premium players are allowed to store a maximum of 15,000 items.

Tibia History Snippet

Until December 2015, each city had its own depot chest which you could only access from the city's depot. With the winter update 2015, we introduced the global depot and thus, the depot chest of each city turned into a numbered depot box inside the global depot chest.

If you are looking for items you had stored in a city depot before that update, simply check its corresponding depot box. You can find out its number in the list to the right.

Inbox and Store Inbox

Click on the mailbox in your locker to acces your inbox. If you have received any parcels or letters, they will arrive here.

Also, if you have lost a house, your items will be transferred to your inbox. Further, all items you have bought via the Market will arrive in your inbox.

Please note that your mail inbox is different from your Store Inbox.

The Store inbox contains items you have bought in the Store or received as daily reward. You can open the Store inbox wherever you are by clicking on this small button next to the helmet slot of your inventory.

You are looking for a specific item in your locker but cannot remember where you put it?
You can search for items by name if you click on this small magnifier icon.

You do not need to type the full name to get results.

Tick the box "Show Locker only" if you only want to see items that you own.

 

After clicking on "Show search result" at the bottom right,
you can see whether the items are located in your depot boxes, stash or inbox.

 

You can retrieve all items at once by clicking "Retrieve displayed Items" or you can retrieve a single item with drag-and-drop.

 

You can also use filter options such as the NPC trader filter to only display items meeting this criteria.

gamenews.headline: The Market
gamenews.message:
The Market allows you to trade items and Tibia Coins with other players.
 

Open the Market by clicking on the respective button in your depot locker.

 

 

Browse through the various categories (1) or use the search (2) to find the item you are interested in.

Select an item in the object list below Categories to see its current sell and buy offers sorted by the piece price.


The average item prices are calculated on a daily basis for each game world.

Sell offers that are 25 % or more above a game world's average price are displayed in red, as are buy offers that are 25 % or more below the average.

If you lack the money or items to accept a sell or buy offer, this offer will be greyed out.

For more details on the selected item, including trading statistics of the last 30 days, click on the Details button in the lower right corner of the Market window.

 


How to create a SELL offer:

 


1) Select an item and click Sell in the Create Offer section. You can only sell items that are stored in your depot chest.
2) Enter the Piece Price you want to charge for one unit of the item you are about to offer.
3) Select the number of item units you want to sell via the slider Amount. To increase the slider's step size, hold Shift, Ctrl or Shift+Ctrl while using the slider.
4) Tick the box Anonymous if you do not want to reveal that you are the creator of this offer.
5) If you have entered everything correctly, click on Create to place the offer.

You can only place a sell offer if you have enough gold to pay the fee. Hover over your balance in the lower left corner of the Market window to see how much you have in cash and in your bank account.


How to accept a SELL offer to buy something from someone else:

 


1) Select an item and click on the offer of your choice in the Sell Offers list.
2) Set the number of item units you want to buy via the slider Amount.
3) Check the total amount you will have to pay and click on Accept to seal the deal.


How to create a BUY offer:

 


1) Select an item and click Buy in the Create Offer section. You can only place a buy offer if you have enough gold to pay the fee and your offered price.
2) Enter the Piece Price you are willing to spend on one unit of the item you want to buy.
3) Select the number of item units you want to buy via the slider Amount. To increase the slider's step size, hold Shift, Ctrl or Shift+Ctrl while using the slider.
4) Tick the box Anonymous if you do not want others to know that you are the creator of this offer.
5) If you have entered everything correctly, click on Create to place the offer.

Items from the Market will be transferred directly to your mail inbox which you access via your depot locker.

How to accept a BUY offer to sell something to someone else:

 


1) Select an item and click on the offer of your choice in the Buy Offers list. You can only sell items that are stored in your depot chest.
2) Set the number of item units you want to sell via the slider Amount.
3) Check the total amount you will earn and click on Accept to seal the deal.

 

Check the section My Offers to get an overview of your current offers and your offer history.

gamenews.headline: The Stash
gamenews.message:
The stash offers a convenient way to stow and retrieve your items.
 

You can stow stackable items and most items that are tradable via the Market in your stash.
This includes brand-new rings, amulets, and gear without imbuements and tiers.

Your stash can be accessed via your depot locker.

 

Stow items in the stash

There are different ways to stow items in your stash:

Drag & drop an item on the stash icon. Select Stow or Stow all items of this type in the item's context menu. To stow a container's content, drag & drop it on the stash icon or select Stow container's content from the context menu.

While the stash itself has no item limit, you can stow only 10,000 items at a time.

Retrieve items from the stash

To retrieve items from the stash,
click on the item and select or type the amount you want to retrieve.

 

Retrieved items are automatically sorted into the containers
you have selected for their category in the Manage Containers dialog.

Filters and Sorting Options

Use predefined filters to display items of a specific item category,
and to show only those sellable to the selected NPC trader.
If you are looking for a specific item, type its name into the search bar.

You can also sort items by name, Market value, sell-to value, and quantity.

 

Stowed astral sources will be taken directly from your stash
if you want to imbue your equipment at an imbuing shrine.

gamenews.headline: Item Cyclopedia
gamenews.message:
The Item Cyclopedia provides useful information about most tradable items in Tibia.
 
Click on the respective control button to open the Tibia Cyclopedia and select the Items tab.

Browse through the various categories (1) or use the search function (2) to find the item you are interested in.

Click on an item to get further details such as the description and stats of the item, as well as info on NPCs buying or selling this item for which price and where. In addition, you will also see the average Market price of this item on your game world.

 

You can choose whether the NPC buy value or the average Market value should be used for item price calculations in various analytics tools.

If you have premium status, you can also set your own loot value for each item.

If you have selected an item and check this box, the item will be tracked during your character's hunting session.

 

For more information on item tracking, check the Compendium entry about Analytics Tools under Client Features.

You can also add an item to your skipped loot list if you check this box.

 

For more information on skipped loot, check the Compendium entry about Quick Looting under Client Features.

gamenews.headline: Cyclopedia Map
gamenews.message:
The Cyclopedia Map is a world map of Tibia.
Discover areas to gradually unlock interesting info and details about the world.
 

You can open the Cyclopedia Map directly by clicking on the respective button next to the minimap.

 

 

Your character's current position is marked with a red pin on the map. This position is centered when you open the Cyclopedia map.

Use your mouse cursor to drag and drop the map in order to move it around. To zoom in and out of the map, hover your mouse cursor over the map and scroll the mouse wheel. Using the mouse wheel in combination with the SHIFT key changes the current floor.

If you want to center the map back to your character's current position, click the middle of the compass rose.

You can also use the navigation slider to switch the map to upper or lower floors.

  Hover your mouse cursor over the slider and scroll your mouse wheel up or down to switch floors.
A click on the blue or red section of the slider will show the map of the floor above or below you.
You can also drag and drop the slider to the map floor you would like to see.

Choose your preferred view of the map and the filter marks you would like to see displayed on the map.

The Cyclopedia Map is subdivided in different areas and subareas.

Click on the name of an area or subarea to select and highlight it on the map.


You can use the Cyclopdia Map to navigate your character.
SHIFT+Left-click in your Cyclopedia Map and your character starts walking to the desired position as long as the destination is reachable, within range and on the same layer.

Discover subareas!

1) Select a subarea.
2) Click the respective button to start discovering.

 

Points of Interest will now be randomly placed in the selected subarea. You will have to find 7 of them in order to discover the subarea completely.

 

If you have trouble finding enough of them, you can click the button Reset Points of Interest. All points will be randomly placed again and you can start over. Please note, though, that you will lose your current discovery progress of the subarea in question if you reset Points of Interest.

Once you have fully discovered enough subareas, you will unlock new useful features of the Cyclopedia Map:

Fully discovered at least 30% of all subareas of an area: locations of NPCs within that respective area can be shown on the map.

Fully discovered at least 70%: passages to subareas on other floor and teleports are displayed as stair symbols on the map.

Fully discovered all subareas of an area: creatures that occur in those subareas are listed when you click on a subarea's name or on a passages symbol that leads to this subarea. Creatures for which the Bestiary entry has not yet been unlocked are displayed as a silhouette.

In addition, a player who has completed an area will be notified whenever a raid is about to take place in that area within the next hour.

Visit to NPC Charos in the Adventurers' Guild to find out more about a special outfit you can unlock through discovering the Tibian world.

gamenews.headline: Battle List
gamenews.message:
The battle list shows all characters and monsters in your current battle range.
Use it to attack your targets accurately!

Press or click the battle list button to open the battle list in your sidebar:

 

If you press Spacebar in Chat Off mode, you will attack the next target in your battle list.
You can also set your own hotkey for this.

 

Battle list filters allow you to show or hide members of eleven different groups:
players, knights, paladins, druids, sorcerers, summons, NPCs, monsters,
non-skulled players, party members, and players of your own guild.

 

You can also sort the creatures shown in your battle list by certain critera.

 

Left-click on a creature to attack, right-click on it to open the context menu with further options.

 

You can also create secondary battle lists.

 

Any secondary battle list will have a plus sign in its icon. Its name is of a darker grey, while the main battle list's name is bright grey.

 

You can rename your battle lists to make them easier to identify.

gamenews.headline: Action Bars
gamenews.message:
Make use of the buttons in your action bar to quickly trigger actions or messages.

Action bars are displayed below your game window.
Right-click on an action button to assign a spell, object, text or hotkey to it.

 

(1) Click on Assign Spell to open a small window listing the various spells. Select a spell.

(2) Click OK to assign it to the action button. You can now trigger the spell by clicking on this button in your action bar.

You can also open the spell list window via the control buttons below your inventory to assign a spell by dragging and dropping it on an action button.

 

If you select Assign Object, your mouse cursor will turn into a crosshair.

 

Click on an item to assign it to the action button. Choose your preferred action in the window that will pop up.

 

You can also drag&drop an item on an action button to assign it.

 

 

 

(1) Click on Assign Text to open a small window where you can enter text.

(2) Click OK to assign the text to this action button. If you want to send the text right away when clicking the action button, select send automatically before hitting OK.

 

You can also assign a hotkey to an action button to trigger it via this key.

(1) Click on Assign Hotkey to open this window. Press the key or key combination you want to assign.

(2) Click OK to assign the hotkey to this action button. The hotkey will be displayed in the upper right corner of the action button.

 

Use the small arrow buttons on the left and right side of an action bar to navigate through it.

Clicking the small lock on the right allows you to lock or unlock the ability to assign actions via drag&drop.

 

You can adjust your general action bar settings via the Options menu. You can have up to three action bars on the left, right, and bottom with 50 action buttons per bar.

gamenews.headline: Hotkeys
gamenews.message:
Hotkeys allow you to quickly trigger actions by pressing a specific key or key combination.
Define hotkey presets for your characters to optimise your gameplay!

You can have the hotkey preset for a specific character automatically activated upon login.

Press or open the Options menu and go to the Hotkeys section. Check this box:

Either click Add to create a new hotkey preset or Rename to change the name an existing one.

Make sure to name the hotkey preset exactly like the character it is meant for and click OK. Done!

 
There are two chat modes in Tibia. This is important to know for your hotkey presets.

Chat On

You can write text in the chat console.

If you have assigned an action to a letter key (e.g. A), pressing this key will trigger the action but you will not be able to type the letter in the entry line of the chat console.

Chat Off

You cannot write any text in the entry line of the console.

Per default, you can walk with WASD in this mode.

Chat On*

This temporary mode is a special case. Per default, if you press the Return key in Chat Off mode, it temporarily switches to Chat On* so that you can write one message in the console. As soon as you press Return to send the message, your chat mode will be set to Chat Off again.
The small button on the right side of the entry line of the chat console tells you which chat mode is currently active. Click it to switch between the two chat modes.

To assign and edit hotkeys, first select the hotkey preset you want to edit.

Now select the chat mode for which you want to edit hotkeys:

 


If you want your hotkeys to work in both modes, you need to set them in both modes!
So this basically means that you have to set up your hotkeys twice.

 

Check the box Show Advanced Options to access all hotkeys via the three hotkey subsections under Controls: general hotkeys, action bar hotkeys and custom hotkeys.

If you leave the box unchecked, only basic options will be displayed in the Options menu. With this setting, you can only assign hotkeys to predefined actions via the button Hotkeys.


If you have checked the box Show Advanced Options,
you can set your personal hotkeys in the subsection Custom Hotkeys.

Let's create a new entry:

Click on New Action and select the action of your choice.

 

(1) Click on Assign Spell to open a small window listing the various spells. Select a spell.

(2) Click OK to close this window.

 

If you select Assign Object, your mouse cursor will turn into a crosshair. Click on an item and choose your preferred action in the window that will pop up.

Click OK to close this window.

(1) Click on Assign Text to open a small window and enter your text message.

(2) Click OK to close this window. If you want to send the text right away when clicking the action button, select send automatically before hitting OK.

Now we need to actually assign a hotkey to the action we just selected:

(1) To do so, click on the small pencil icon in the field First Key. This will open a window where you can edit the hotkey. 

(2) Press the key or key combination of your choice.

(3) Click OK to close this window.

 

  


You can assign up to 2 hotkeys to every action. You need to have a hotkey assigned in the column First Key to be able to assign a hotkey in the column Second Key.

Always remember to save your hotkey changes and settings before closing the hotkey dialog!
To do so you can either click Apply to save your changes or click OK to save your changes and close the dialog.

 

If you are looking for a specific hotkey in a hotkey section, you can also use the search bar.

 

How to assign a hotkey to toggle between Chat On an Off:

  • Set hotkey preset for chat mode to Chat Off, scroll to the predefined action Chat Mode: Set to Chat On. Assign the hotkey of your choice.
  • Set hotkey preset for chat mode to Chat On, scroll to the predefined action Chat Mode: Set to Chat Off. Assign the same hotkey.
  • Click Apply to save or OK to save and close the hotkey dialog. Pressing this hotkey now toggles between the chat modes.

gamenews.headline: Analytics Tools
gamenews.message:
Analyse and optimise your hunting sessions by making use of various statistics.
 
Click on the respective button below your inventory to access the analytics window in your sidebar. Click the Analyser tools you want to use to open them.

Make good use of the additional sidebars you can open on the left and right side of your screen.

 


Hunting Session Analyser

This analyser summarises important values of your current hunting session.

A hunting session starts when you log in, and ends when you log out.

You can start a new session at any time via the small button in the upper right corner. Please note that previously collected data will be discarded and the data in all other Analytics tools will be reset if you start a new hunting session.

You can also copy your session results to your clipboard, or save them to a .txt or .json file via this menu to share them with your friends and enemies.


Party Hunt Analyser

This analyser is similar to the Hunting Session Analyser. It however not only summarises important values of your current hunting session, but of everyone in the party. On the other hand, it is not as detailed as the Hunting Session Analyser. An overview of the party's combined data is also given.

A session starts once a party is formed. You can reset the data at any time via the small button in the upper right corner. Please note that previously collected data will be discarded and the data in all other Analytics tools will be reset if you start a new hunting session.

Premium players who are also the party leader can switch between loot types "Market" and "Leader", which affects how the values are calculated.

You can also copy your session results to your clipboard via this menu to share them with your friends and enemies.


Drop Tracker

It lists all items you have marked for tracking in the Cyclopedia and tells you how many of them you have looted since tracking was started. Click Add Tracked Drop to add items via the Cyclopedia.

Free account players can track up to five items at once per character, premium players can track up to 50 items at once per character.

If a monster drops an item you have marked for tracking, you will be notified about it in the drop tracker and the loot channel. Also, a message will pop up at the bottom of the game window.

 

As long as the notification is visible in the drop tracker,
you can hover over it to see when this item dropped.
If several party members track the same item, all of them will be notified whenever the item is dropped by a monster.

As a premium player, you can also specify a minimum gold value for items you want to have tracked automatically in the drop tracker. Click the small button in the upper right corner of the window to set a value.

If you are already tracking the maximum amount of items (50), newly dropped items that exceed this value will not be displayed in the drop tracker.


Loot Analyser

This analyser allows you to keep track of items looted during your play session and the resulting profit in gold coins based on the NPC price, average Market price on your world or your individually set price.

You can change the loot value source via the Cyclopedia.

If you click on the small button in the upper right corner, you can also set a target value of your choice.
Use the gauge to track if your current performance is above or below your defined target. Use the graph to see your performance over the last 60 minutes.


Supply Analyser

This analyser shows your current usage of certain consumables, e.g. potions, runes, or consumed food, and the resulting loss in gold coins based on the NPC price, average Market price on your world or your individually set price.

You can change the loot value source via the Cyclopedia.

If you click on the small button in the upper right corner, you can also set a target value of your choice.
Use the gauge to track if your current performance is above or below your defined target. Use the graph to see your performance over the last 60 minutes.


Impact Analyser

This analyser shows your current damage and healing performance.

If you click on the small button in the upper right corner, you can choose to display your recent damage or healing values or your average output for the whole session.
You can also set a target value of your choice via this button. Use the gauge to track if your current performance is above or below your defined target. Use the graph to see your performance over the last 60 minutes.


XP Analyser

This analyser shows your current XP per hour rate and the remaining time to reach the next level.

If you click on the small button in the upper right corner, you can also set a target value of your choice.
Use the gauge to track if your current performance is above or below your defined target. Use the graph to see your performance over the last 60 minutes.

 


Boss Cooldown Tracker

This widget allows you to keep track of the remaining cooldown time of Archfoe bosses which you have killed at least once.

You can either sort unlocked Archfoes by remaining cooldown time or by name. And if you want to check the Bosstiary entry of one of the displayed bosses, just click on their icon to open it.

gamenews.headline: Auto Screenshots
gamenews.message:
Activate this feature to automatically take screenshots of important events.
 

The Auto Screenshots feature can be configured in the client options.

Activate Show Advanced Options to access the Misc category and the corresponding Screenshots subcategory.

 

Choose if you want your whole client interface to be included in the screenshots or if you only want to capture the game window.

 

You can select different ingame events that will trigger an automatic screenshot.
Hover over the  button with your mouse cursor to learn more about each event.

 

Your local screenshots folder can be accessed via the client.

 

All screenshots are named after a certain pattern:

date, time, character name, event name, backlog number.

Assign a hotkey in the general hotkeys section to trigger the screenshots feature manually.

gamenews.headline: Client Settings and Minimap Export and Import
gamenews.message:
Use the export and import function to easily backup your client settings and minimap.
 

Under Help in the options menu you can find the buttons Export All Options, which exports your settings (including hotkeys) and action bars, as well as Export Minimap, which lets you export your current minimap.

 

Import Options/Minimap allows you to import both options and minimap after export.

gamenews.headline: Mount and Outfit Presets
gamenews.message:
The Customise Character dialog allows for the creation of presets with which you can quickly change your appearance.
 

Right-click on your character and choose Customise Character.

 

To create a new preset, click on the radio button next to Preset and then on New under Manage Presets. The new preset will appear in the list on the right. The colours of the outfit, the mount, and the familiar will be saved.

 

If you change your appearance and click on Save, the selected preset will be overwritten with the new configuration.

"Copy (colours)" copies the colours of your outfit or colourisable mount to clipboard. 
"Paste (colours)" applies the colours you saved to clipboard. 
"Copy (all)" copies the information about your outfit, colours, mount, and familiar to clipboard. 
You can share this saved data with others. They just need to copy it to their clipboard and use "Paste (all)" to apply your configuration.

gamenews.headline: Quick Looting
gamenews.message:
Use quick looting to loot more efficiently and customise it to your liking.
 

Quick looting allows you to loot all items in a monster corpse with a single click.

If you use Classic Controls, you can choose between the following mouse options to quick loot:

 

 

If you use Left Smart-Click, you quick loot all items if you press Alt + left click on a corpse.

If you use Regular Controls, you quick loot all items if you press Shift + right click on a corpse.
   

As a premium player, you can also loot a specific item within a corpse with a single click:

 

Classic Controls Left Smart-Click Regular Controls

If you use the animated mouse cursor, a special icon will indicate quick looting. You can activate this cursor in the Options menu.

 

If you tick off the option Show Loot Highlighting under Game Window in the Options menu, unlooted corpses will be visually highlighted.

The effect disappears as soon as any player eligible for loot either a) opens the corpse, b) quick-loots the corpse or c) the corpse expires. The highlight does not appear for empty corpses, player corpses and cooperative loot from bosses.


Quick Loot Nearby Corpses

Set up the hotkey of your choice to easily grab loot as you walk through hunting grounds.
You can loot all fields directly beneath and adjacent to your character (9 fields, up to 30 corpses at once, per field) with a single click.

 

Refine which items to loot:

Premium status allows you to refine quick looting with two filters: Skipped Loot and Accepted Loot.
While you can only use one of the two filters at a time, you can switch between the two of them as you please.

Here's how you set them up:

Open the Manage Containers dialog.
You can access it via the Cyclopedia, the context menu of a container or a hotkey which you can assign in the Hotkey section of the Options menu.

 

Choose Skipped Loot to exclude certain items from quick looting:

(A) You can add an item to your Skipped Loot list via an item's context menu. Once added, you can remove that item from the list again via its context menu. (B) You can also add or remove items via the "Skip when Quick Looting" tick box in the Item Cyclopedia.

 

Choose Accepted Loot to only quick loot items that you have added to your accepted loot list. You can add an item to your Accepted Loot list or remove it via the item's context menu, similar to how it works with the Skipped Loot list.

You can also remove an item on the right-hand side of the Manage Loot Containers dialog by clicking the X-button.

 

You can add up to 500 items to both your skipped loot list and your accepted loot list.

gamenews.headline: Colourised Loot Value
gamenews.message:
Based on their gold value, items are highlighted with a coloured frame.
 

This allows to identify the approximate value of the item at a glance.

The colour depends on the loot value, which can be determined in the Items section of the Cyclopedia, either using the NPC buy value, the average Market price or your own preferred value.

Each colour represents a certain gold value range:

  • No frame means a gold value has yet to be defined in the Cyclopedia or equals 0.
  • Grey frame means a gold value of 1 - 999.
  • Green frame means a gold value of 1,000 - 9,999.
  • Blue frame means a gold value of 10,000 - 99,999.
  • Purple frame means a gold value of 100,000 - 999,999.
  • Yellow frame means a gold value of 1,000,000+.

 

According to this colour pattern, the individual items in every loot message are also highlighted in the respective colour.

 

In case you prefer a rather subtle coloured hint in the upper left corner instead of the frames or do not want to use see value colours at all, you can change it in the client's Interface options.

gamenews.headline: Manage Containers
gamenews.message:
How to quickly manage and arrange the contents of your backpacks:
 

Manage Containers

Premium players can use the Manage Containers dialog to assign categories to containers.
Items obtained from looting, NPCs, the depot and the stash are then automatically placed in their assigned containers.

You can open the dialog via the context menu of a container, the Cyclopedia, or a configurable hotkey.

Under "Loot", you manage the containers for items looted from creatures. 
Under "Obtain", you manage containers for items obtained through other means.

To assign a categoy, press the crosshairs button next to it and click on the container of your choice. Done!

From now on, items of this category will be automatically put into that container.

To remove a category from a container, simply press the X button next to the category in the Manage Containers dialog.

You can assign multiple categories to the same container.

If you hover over the small bag icon in the lower right corner of a container that has at least one category assigned to it, these categories will be displayed.

Items of categories you have not assigned to a specific container, will be placed into the Unassigned container for looted and obtained items.

Per default, this is your main container, the one you have equipped in the body slot. You can also select different containers via the Manage Containers dialog.

Quick Sort Container

You can sort the contents of your backpacks according to various criteria by opening the respective menu.

Sorting options include sorting ascending/descending by name, weight, expiry and stack size.

Additionally, you can sort nested containers, prioritise backpacks to be sorted first within the inventory, and you can switch on the manual sort mode to be able to drag and drop items to any location within the backpack.

gamenews.headline: VIP List
gamenews.message:
The VIP list helps you to keep track of your friends and enemies.
 

Open VIP list: Press or click the VIP list button to open the VIP list in your sidebar.

 

Add VIP

Enter a character's name to create the corresponding entry in your VIP list.

 

Edit VIP

VIP list entries can be edited. You can assign a special icon and enter a short description. Set a check mark if you want to receive an automatic message whenever the selected character logs into the game and tick the groups you want the character to be listed in.

 

VIP List Filters

You can sort your VIP list by certain criteria and clear it up by hiding offline characters and group names.

 

Add Groups

Keep your VIP list neat and tidy and categorise your entries in groups. Premium players can add up to 5 additional groups to their VIP list.

gamenews.headline: Party List
gamenews.message:
The party list shows all party members and their summons.
When they are nearby, their health points and mana will be displayed as well.

Click the party list button in your sidebar:

 

Party list filters allow you to show or hide members of six different groups:
players, knights, paladins, druids, sorcerers and summons.

 

You can also sort your party members by certain criteria.

 

Right-click on it to open the context menu with further options.

gamenews.headline: Team Finder
gamenews.message:
Use the Team Finder to quickly and easily organise a hunt or find a group to play with.
 

Organise an Activity

Go to the Assemble Team tab in the Social dialog.

 

Choose the settings which reflect what kind of team members you are looking for.

 

By clicking on the shield icon, you can set the level range which allows sharing XP between the lowest level player and the highest level player, with your level being in the middle.

 

Click on to create your notice, which also opens a chat channel.

You can then either accept, invite or reject players who want to join. Inviting them adds them to the team channel, giving you a chance to talk to them before either accepting or rejecting them.

 

Look for a Team

Go to the Join Team tab in the Social dialog.

 

Choose the settings which reflect what kind of team you are looking for.

 

Once you have found a team you would like to join, select Join Team.

 

You will be notified once you have been accepted, invited or rejected. In case you are accepted or invited to the team, you will automatically join the team channel.

gamenews.headline: Loot e Gold
gamenews.message:
Auto loot

!autoloot on manda o loot direto para as suas backpacks.
!flask on/off liga ou desliga a coleta de flasks vazios.

Auto Bank

O item Auto Bank (Store) deposita no banco o gold que você coleta, sem encher a mochila.
Use o item para ligar e !autobank para ligar ou desligar.

Criatura do dia

Todo dia uma criatura dá experiência em dobro e loot extra. Ela aparece no client.

Lembre: com 14 h de stamina ou menos o loot cai pela metade.
